articles.title: Morgan Stanley says it is among the first banks to tokenize real world assets
articles.snippet: The bank's announcement follows the launch of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation’s Tokenization Service, or DTS, on Oct. 28.

articles.title: Jack Dorsey's Block faces $764 million DOJ settlement as bitcoin profit plunges 50%
articles.snippet: The proposed agreement would resolve a federal anti-money-laundering investigation, while lower Cash App trading fees halved Block's quarterly bitcoin gross profit.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.snippet: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

articles.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
articles.snippet: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

articles.title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
articles.snippet: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.
